evidence.directly_looked_at: PDF printed p27 (zero-based PDF p1), Table 1 and Table 2; printed p28 (zero-based PDF p2) composite/1662 chronology discussion
bound_findings: Table 1 distinguishes the un-dated 紅葉山文庫《曆學全書》eight-work composite, a Kangxi-period 《梅勿庵算書》 group and 雍正元年(1723)《曆算全書》 as distinct bibliographic assemblages.

Table 2 separately records 《曆學駢枝》 with 康熙元年(1662) associated with its bibliographic/preliminary date and names the prefatory author; this does NOT authenticate the exact impression date of a particular surviving leaf.
The article argues for post-1706 composite assemblage chronology by comparison of works and associated dated pieces, rather than assigning a single component date to every work.
evidence.scope_limit: The article's identified published comparisons are secondary scholarship. The present review has not independently inspected original 1662 preface leaves in the source holding; no precise ancient first printing or 1723 textual descent is asserted.

chronology_firewall.work_or_preface: The 1662 Kangxi-1 bibliographic date is bound to introductory/work-level evidence only until an original leaf or publisher colophon can prove a stronger claim.
chronology_firewall.component_edition: The Sinica 840 Kangxi '刊本' classification is explicitly component-specific, not a timestamp for all 12 bound volumes.
chronology_firewall.aggregate_edition: 1723 雍正元年《兼濟堂纂刻梅勿菴先生曆算全書》 is a separate later compilation/publication layer.
chronology_firewall.physical_copy: The exact printed layer, composite assembly date and historical copy history of Sinica 840 and any alternative 1662-labeled item remain unverified.
chronology_firewall.textual_identity: Same title plus date does not prove corresponding 91.310625 or 91.320625 native glyphs or copying direction.
